decision: retain existing Soft Step; reject both bounded candidates
settings: Same committed fixtures, four substeps, 120 warm-up and 600 measured steps, each sleep mode compared separately.
timing_limits: Sequential repeated runs on one host; retain full spread. Tiny fixtures show substantial process warm-up variation. Whole-step timings include graph, contacts and changed trajectories; they are not isolated solver cost or speedup evidence when quality fails.
decision_reasons: Ordering passes quality but adds capacity-scaled memory exceeding existing budgets; timing and quality evidence does not justify adoption.
Two-pass improves bridge penetration but violates unchanged toppling, pyramid, piles, table and inverted-mass quality bounds and the existing ten-box stack drift assertion.
Keep all production solver code unchanged. This rejects the one-sweep bounded adaptation, not the published method or an unconstrained implementation.

work_contract.interval: 720 complete steps, including warm-up; counters saturate at uint64 maximum
work_contract.constraint_evaluations: Actual manifold calls in biased and relaxation stages, including attempted two-pass work and rollback fallback; excludes warm start/restitution.
work_contract.fallbacks: Per island build; reason bits can overlap. Cycles cannot arise from strictly ordered height edges; equal heights are the exercised ambiguity fallback.
work_contract.baseline_experiment_counters: Unavailable: baseline is uninstrumented; do not substitute last-step counts for total work.

scratch.ordered: 16 bytes/body + 8 bytes/contact plus 128-byte context and alignment
scratch.two-pass: 40 bytes/body + 152 bytes/contact plus 176-byte context and alignment
